objective: fixed-input exact-output prediction, base vs arm A checkpoint 431, across specification levels, exposed vs lineage-disjoint unexposed train functions

exposed.definition: a record in arm A's 2,400-record selection (preflight selection_sha256 598eef61...)

input_kinds.upstream: first discriminating call from the record's own upstream tests (exposed: 120/120 were literal arm A SFT targets; unexposed: never shown to arm A)
input_kinds.novel: first discriminating fixed-order literal perturbation of an upstream call, absent from every test of every record in the group

scope_limits: MBPP only: the unexposed groups contain 13 HumanEval records
simple and moderate tiers only: the unexposed groups contain 6 complex records; arm A's selection was 60% complex, so exposure is confounded with complexity outside this matched stratum
bug-family mix differs between cohorts (exposed boundary 38 vs 21, comparison 15 vs 28); a family-stratified sensitivity analysis is pre-registered
cohort.selection: deterministic, arm-blind: seeded-hash order of groups and records; discrimination verified by executing each call on reference and mutant under ==; reference result must round-trip as a Python literal of <= 120 characters; items whose call appears in any prompt level are excluded

levels.A0: production information: buggy code under test and record specification
levels.A1: NOT RUN: the specification already is the full public upstream statement; no further public docstring/type information exists for MBPP
levels.A2: NOT APPLICABLE: synthetic function records have no repository context
levels.A3: A0 plus a non-revealing invariant: the result's Python type, and its length when sized
levels.A4: DIAGNOSTIC, NON-DEPLOYABLE: the fixed implementation is shown instead of the buggy one (pure execution reasoning); never enters training or confirmation
levels.A0_answer_schema: schema/extraction control (replaces Probe 3B): A0 information, no prefill, 'ANSWER: <Python literal>' requested; strict and lenient extraction reported

generation.chat: production system prompt and user prompt layout (engine/test_generation_prompt.py); A0/A3/A4 assistant turn prefilled with the bare, unfenced 'assert <frozen call> == ' (the production instruction forbids fences and arm A's SFT targets are bare assertions)
generation.runner: scripts/run_fixed_input_probe.py via scripts/gpu_run.py start (detached, logs, PID, heartbeat, completion receipt per arm); resumable per (item, level)

scoring.answer: prefill levels: text up to the first newline (a stray trailing ``` removed); control: an 'ANSWER:' line (strict), else 'assert <call> == X' (lenient), else nonanswer
scoring.correct: the sandboxed reference passes `assert <call> == (<answer>)` - the evaluator's own reference-validity semantics

inference.method: paired cluster bootstrap over semantic group (one function per group)
inference.multiplicity: Holm across the primary H4 and H1 contrasts

decision_rules.improves: paired lower 95% bound > 0; 'supported' needs lower bound >= +5 points
H4: SFT-base A0 on exposed items not improved -> weaken distribution shift; strengthen objective/capacity explanations
improved on exposed but not on unexposed -> support memorisation/exposure failure (also report exposed-minus-unexposed interaction with its CI)
improved on both train cohorts -> distribution shift can be neither supported nor rejected here: no adequate external cohort exists (census), so H4's distribution-shift arm stays open
decision_rules.H4_sub: exposed upstream items were literal SFT targets; exposed novel items test within-function generalisation; report both
H1_H3: A3-A0 lower bound > 0 and point >= 5 (either arm): non-revealing missing context matters
only A4-A0 improves: A0 is under-specified for value prediction; execution given the fixed code is feasible
neither A3 nor A4 improves over A0: capacity/reasoning more likely limiting (H3 strengthened)
A4 absolute accuracy (base) < 0.5: execution reasoning itself is limited even with the fixed code shown
decision_rules.control: if SFT-base at A0 changes sign between the prefill schema and the answer-schema control, the A0 result is flagged schema-dependent and not interpreted
decision_rules.sensitivity: bug-family-stratified SFT-base difference (families with >= 10 functions per cohort)
